title: Follow the Crimson Bee
summary: Your Ghastly hums north. Follow it to the Nether Mansion, the Cult of Azazel's Sacred City, and talk to the Welcomer who greets every pilgrim at its gate.

goals.say: Gold everywhere. A Welcomer bows at the gate as if you were expected.
The Welcomer steps aside. 'The quarries are below. Mind the Manipulators. They don't like visitors.'
goals.name: The Welcomer

threats.name: The Welcomer
threats.target_line: Welcome, pilgrim, to the Sacred City. Have you come to give, or to receive?
talk: I'm looking for prisoners from Ashford.
Workers. We call them workers here. The quarries are below.
Words. Here, everything is gold or on its way to becoming gold.
I welcome. I have welcomed for a very long time. Nobody has ever asked me that.
